description.value: Fat Boy Kitchen is a neighbourhood restaurant on Victoria Drive in east Vancouver, a commercial corridor popular with local cyclists. The name suggests hearty, filling fare, and the business offers takeaway service — handy for cyclists looking to grab a meal on the go. It sits in the Sunset neighbourhood, a residential area well-connected to Vancouver's cycling network.
